_comment: Allowlist anti-slopsquatting (check-deps.mjs). Toda dep nova exige adicao EXPLICITA aqui apos verificar que e legitima.

_justifications.typescript-7: npm alias `npm:typescript@7.0.2` (see apps/web, apps/bff, packages/api-contracts devDependencies) — deliberately pinned TypeScript 7 preview; `tsc` path is node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc. Not a registry name; the alias target `typescript@7.0.2` exists on npm.
_justifications.@argismonitor/api-contracts: In-repo workspace package at packages/api-contracts (package.json name field); consumed via `file:../../packages/api-contracts` from apps/web and apps/bff. Not published.
_justifications.@omniroute/ffi-darwin-arm64: In-repo prebuilt FFI artifact (packages/omniroute-ffi-darwin-arm64); optionalDependency of @omniroute/ffi via `file:../omniroute-ffi-darwin-arm64`.
_justifications.@omniroute/ffi-darwin-x64: In-repo prebuilt FFI artifact (packages/omniroute-ffi-darwin-x64); optionalDependency of @omniroute/ffi via `file:`.
_justifications.@omniroute/ffi-linux-arm64-gnu: In-repo prebuilt FFI artifact (packages/omniroute-ffi-linux-arm64-gnu); optionalDependency of @omniroute/ffi via `file:`.
_justifications.@omniroute/ffi-linux-x64-gnu: In-repo prebuilt FFI artifact (packages/omniroute-ffi-linux-x64-gnu); optionalDependency of @omniroute/ffi via `file:`.
_justifications.@omniroute/ffi-win32-x64: In-repo prebuilt FFI artifact (packages/omniroute-ffi-win32-x64); optionalDependency of @omniroute/ffi via `file:`.
_justifications.@tauri-apps/cli: Tauri 2 CLI, declared in apps/desktop/package.json (devDependencies) — the active desktop shell after the Electron removal.
_justifications.hono: Hono HTTP framework; apps/web (^4.0.0) and apps/bff (^4.13.5) dependencies.
_justifications.@hono/zod-validator: Hono + Zod request validator; apps/bff dependency.
_justifications.@trpc/server: tRPC server runtime; apps/bff and apps/web dependencies.
_justifications.@tailwindcss/vite: Tailwind CSS v4 Vite plugin; apps/web devDependency.
_justifications.web-vitals: Core Web Vitals reporting; apps/web dependency.
_justifications.use-intl: i18n hooks used by the committed root test/tooling setup (root devDependency).
_justifications.remark-gfm: GitHub-Flavored Markdown remark plugin; root devDependency.
_justifications.@testing-library/dom: Peer dep obrigatoria de @testing-library/react v16 (adicionada no PR #11224); Refs #9985.
_justifications.@testing-library/user-event: Utilitario oficial do ecossistema testing-library para testes de UI (adicionada no PR #11224); Refs #9985.
_justifications.babel-plugin-react-compiler: Official React Compiler Babel plugin (facebook/react, MIT). Required peer of Next.js 16 `reactCompiler: true`; Next declares it optional (`*`) and does not auto-install. Added by PR #11783 / issue #67.
_justifications.eslint-plugin-react-hooks: React Hooks lint rules (set-state-in-effect, immutability, refs, purity) pinned at 7.0.1 by the release/v3.8.51 cycle; the 224 findings it raised are tracked in #11924. Refs #11924.
